  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:justify;"><span style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition.<br /></span><span style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</span></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:justify;"><span style="background-color:rgba(255,255,255,1);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">On November 3, 2021, Dr. Keh-Shew Lu, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of Diodes Incorporated, (the &#x201c;Company&#x201d;), as well as Brett R. Whitmire, Chief Financial Officer, Emily Yang, Senior Vice President, Worldwide Sales and Marketing, Gary Yu, Senior Vice President, Business Groups and Gurmeet </span><span style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Dhaliwal</span><span style="background-color:rgba(255,255,255,1);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">, Director of Investor Relations, participated in a conference call to discuss the Company&#x2019;s third quarter 2021 financial results. A recording of the conference call has been posted on the Company&#x2019;s website at www.diodes.com, and copy of a transcript of the conference call is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this report.</span></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:justify;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</span></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:justify;"><span style="background-color:rgba(255,255,255,1);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">In the earnings conference call, the Company utilizes financial measures and terms not calculated in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States (&#x201c;GAAP&#x201d;) in order to provide investors with an alternative method for assessing the Company&#x2019;s operating results in a manner that enables investors to more thoroughly evaluate its current performance as compared to past performance. The Company also believes these non-GAAP measures provide investors with a more informed baseline for modeling the Company&#x2019;s future financial performance. Management uses these non-GAAP measures for the same purpose. The Company believes that investors should have access to the same set of tools that management uses in analyzing results. These non-GAAP measures should be considered in addition to results prepared in accordance with GAAP, but should not be considered a substitute for or superior to GAAP results and may differ from similar measures used by other companies. For a description, and reconciliation with GAAP, of these non-GAAP measures see the Company&#x2019;s press release dated November 3, 2021, announcing the Company&#x2019;s third quarter 2021 financial results, a copy of which was furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 3, 2021.</span><span style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;"> The information furnished in this Item 2.02, including the exhibit incorporated by reference, will not be treated as &#x201c;filed&#x201d; for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#x201c;Exchange Act&#x201d;), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section. This information will not be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#x201c;Securities Act&#x201d;), or into another filing under the Exchange Act, unless that filing expressly refers to specific information in this Report.</span></p>

  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:24.25pt;line-height:11.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Keh-Shew Lu - Diodes Incorporated - Chairman, CEO &amp; President</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:6.1pt;line-height:11.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Thank you, Leanne. Welcome, everyone, and thank you for joining us today.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">This quarter represented the fourth consecutive quarter of record revenue and our second consecutive quarter of gross margin expansion, over<br>210 basis points, resulting in record gross margin and profits. Underpinning our growth has been the success of our content expansion initiatives,<br>in particular in the automotive market, where revenue grew over 65% year-over-year and 7% sequentially, contributing to an 8-year CAGR of 30%.<br>Additionally, our Pericom products continued to set new revenue records, achieving 4 consecutive quarters of growth primarily driven by traction<br>in high-end computing and server applications.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Our growth in these higher-margin end markets, combined with increased loading at our LITE-ON Semiconductor facilities have enabled us to<br>increase our topline revenue and margins even in the midst of this supply-constrained environment. Diodes is favorably positioned with a global<br>manufacturing footprint that provides the flexibility to strategically expand our capacity and reduce costs, either by adding equipment to existing<br>lines or converting equipment to larger wafers. These ongoing actions are expected to support our continued growth and margin improvement<br>into next year and toward our 2025 target of $1 billion in gross profit on $2.5 billion in revenue, and a 40% gross margin.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.7pt;line-height:11.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">With that, let me now hand the call over to Brett to discuss our third quarter financial results and our fourth quarter 2021 guidance in more detail.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:24.25pt;line-height:11.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Brett R. Whitmire - Diodes Incorporated - CFO</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:5.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Thanks, Dr. Lu, and good afternoon, everyone. As part of my financial review today, I will focus my comments on the sequential change for each<br>of the line items and would refer you to our press release for a more detailed review of our results as well as the year-over-year comparisons.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.7pt;line-height:11.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Revenue for the third quarter 2021 was a record $471.4 million, an increase of 7% from $440.4 million in the second quarter 2021.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Gross profit for the third quarter was also a record at $181.2 million or a record 38.4% of revenue, increasing 13% or 210 basis points from $159.8<br>million or 36.3% of revenue in the second quarter of 2021. I would also like to point out that our gross profit increased 63% or 250 basis points from<br>$111.1 million or 35.9% of revenue in the third quarter 2020.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">GAAP operating expenses for the third quarter of 2021 were $104 million or 22.1% of revenue and on a non-GAAP basis, were $99.6 million or</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">21.1% of revenue, which excludes $4.1 million of amortization of acquisition-related intangible asset expenses. This compares to non-GAAP<br>operating expenses in the prior quarter of $90.4 million or 20.5% of revenue.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Total other income amounted to approximately $8.3 million for the quarter, consisting of $5.9 million of unrealized gain on investments, $2.2<br>million of other income, $765,000 of interest income, $800,000 in foreign currency gain, partially offset by $1.4 million in interest expense.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.7pt;line-height:11.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Income before taxes and noncontrolling interest in the third quarter 2021 was $85.6 million compared to $70.7 million in the previous quarter.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.7pt;line-height:11.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Turning to income taxes, our effective income tax rate for the third quarter was approximately 17.3%.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">GAAP net income for the third quarter of 2021 was a record $68.4 million or $1.50 per diluted share, a 23% increase compared to GAAP net income<br>of $1.22 per diluted share or $55.4 million in second quarter of 2021. This represents a 194% improvement from $0.51 per diluted share or $27.2<br>million in the third quarter 2020. The share count used to compute GAAP diluted EPS for the third quarter 2021 was 45.6 million shares.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:0.92%;text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:14.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">NOVEMBER 03, 2021 / 9:00PM, DIOD.OQ - Q3 2021 Diodes Inc Earnings Call</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:20.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Non-GAAP adjusted net income in the third quarter was a record $67.3 million or $1.47 per diluted share which excluded, net of tax, $3.3 million<br>of acquisition-related intangible asset costs, $0.3 million of acquisition-related and restructuring costs, and a $4.7 million gain in value on certain<br>LSC investments. This represents a 23% improvement from the second quarter of 2021 of $1.20 per diluted share or $54.6 million and 137%<br>improvement from $0.62 per diluted share or $32.8 million in the third quarter of 2020.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Included in third quarter 2021 GAAP net income and non-GAAP adjusted net income was approximately $8 million, net of tax, of non-cash share-based<br>compensation expense. Excluding share-based compensation expense, both GAAP earnings per share, EPS, and non-GAAP adjusted EPS would<br>have increased by $0.18 per diluted share for the third quarter 2021 and $0.15 for second quarter 2021.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">EBITDA for the third quarter was a record $114.5 million or 24.3% of revenue compared to $99.4 million or 22.6% of revenue in the prior quarter.<br>On a year-over-year basis, EBITDA increased 81% from $63.3 million in the third quarter of 2020, further highlighting our significant operating<br>improvements over the past year.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">We have included in our earnings release a reconciliation of GAAP net income to non-GAAP adjusted net income and GAAP net income to EBITDA,<br>which provides additional details.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Cash flow generated from operations was $98.9 million for the third quarter 2021. Free cash flow was $57.8 million for the third quarter, which<br>included $41.1 million for capital expenditures. Net cash flow in the third quarter was a negative $10.1 million, which included a paydown of $49.7<br>million of total debt.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Turning to the balance sheet, at the end of third quarter, cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash plus short-term investments totaled approximately<br>$292 million. Working capital was $619 million and total debt, including long-term and short term, was $252 million. Our net cash position<br>demonstrates our significant cash generation and earnings power.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">In terms of inventory, at the end of third quarter, total inventory days increased to approximately 99 in the quarter as compared to 96 last quarter.<br>Finished goods inventory days were 27 compared to 26 last quarter. Total inventory dollars increased $18 million to approximately $322.1 million.<br>Total inventory in the quarter consisted of $8.9 million increase in finished goods, a $5.2 million increase in raw materials, and a $3.8 million increase<br>in work in process.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Capital expenditures on a cash basis for the third quarter 2021 were $41.1 million or 8.7% of revenue. We expect to remain within our target model<br>of 5% to 9% for the full year.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.7pt;line-height:11.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Now turning to our outlook ...</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">For the fourth quarter 2021, we expect revenue to increase to approximately $476 million, plus or minus 3%, which represents a record on both<br>an organic and a consolidated basis for a combined increase of about 1% sequentially at the midpoint, which is better than typical seasonality of<br>down 5%. We expect GAAP gross margin on a consolidated basis to be 38.7%, plus or minus 1%. Non-GAAP operating expenses, which are GAAP<br>operating expenses adjusted for amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets, are expected to be approximately 21% of revenue, plus or<br>minus 1%. We expect net interest expense to be approximately $1.2 billion. Our income tax rate is expected to be 18%, plus or minus 3%, and<br>shares used to calculate diluted EPS for the fourth quarter are anticipated to be approximately 46.2 million shares.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Please note that purchasing accounting adjustments of $3.4 million after-tax for previous acquisitions is not included in these non-GAAP estimates.<br>With that said, I now turn the call over to Emily Yang.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:24.25pt;line-height:11.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Emily Yang - Diodes Incorporated - SVP of Worldwide Sales &amp; Marketing</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:5.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Thank you, Brett, and good afternoon. In the third quarter, revenue increased 7% sequentially, which is above the midpoint of our guidance and<br>better than typical seasonality, driven by record revenue, market share gains and strong demand across all regions. Worldwide POS revenue was</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:0.92%;text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:14.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">NOVEMBER 03, 2021 / 9:00PM, DIOD.OQ - Q3 2021 Diodes Inc Earnings Call</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:20.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">another record, driven by record POS revenue in Asia and Europe. Distributor inventory in terms of weeks was flat quarter-over-quarter, which<br>remains below our defined normal range of 11 to 14 weeks.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.7pt;line-height:11.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Looking at Global Sales in the third quarter, Asia represented 80% of revenue, Europe 12% and Americas 8%.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">In terms of our end markets, computing represents 30% of revenue, industrial 24%, consumer 18%, communication 16%, and automotive 12% of<br>revenue. We achieved record revenue in the automotive, industrial, computing and consumer end markets.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.7pt;line-height:11.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Now let me review the end market in greater detail ....</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Starting with Automotive market, revenue grew over 65% year-over-year and 7% sequentially to add a quarterly record to revenues even in a<br>supply-constrained environment. Since launching our entrance into the automotive market in 2013, we have achieved a 30% CAGR. Our ongoing<br>success can be contributed to our content expansion initiatives that have resulted in Diodes' content opportunity increasing to almost $100 per<br>vehicle. As part of this initiative, we have also expanded our product portfolio for a broader set of automotive applications that has resulted in<br>increased design-ins and design wins.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">As evidence of our traction to cover more applications, during the quarter we had strong design-in momentum for gate drivers, high-voltage<br>regulators, Hall-effect sensors and MOSFET in the brushless DC motors, electric power steering, cooling fans, water pumps, power windows, door<br>locks, infotainment, battery managed systems and Advanced Driving Assistance Systems. Wireless charging USB Type-C charging and 40V battery<br>systems continued to drive demand for MOSFETs and protected low switches.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">We also saw strong demand for automotive-grade rectifiers in wiring harness applications as well as our bipolar transistors and LED linear drivers<br>in various lighting applications, including rear brake lights, turning lights, fog lights and carpet lighting. DC-DC Buck converters also received strong<br>demand in infotainment, forward lighting, taillights, instrument clusters, telematics and ADAS.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">During the quarter, our Pericom products for the automotive space also continued to gain strong momentum with increasing design-ins for USB<br>Type-A charging controllers, I/O expanders and crystal prism oscillators in the infotainment. Our broad portfolios of high-temperature crystal<br>oscillators led the growth in the automotive business, contributing to the strong performance of the Pericom product line during the quarter.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">In the Industrial market, revenue also reached a quarterly record, growing 66% over the prior year and 17% sequentially across a diverse set of<br>applications, including power supplies, power tools, smart metering, power distribution systems, machine automated systems and security systems.<br>Bipolar transistors and synchronized controllers are gaining traction in power supply applications and PCI Express packet switch from the Pericom<br>product [line] (corrected by company after the call) are gaining momentum in embedded applications.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Newly introduced stepdown LED drivers in a compound package won several new design-ins for LED lighting applications. Additionally, our gate<br>driver IC's Trench MOS technology and voltage regulators are seeing continued success in the brushless DC motor, cooling fans and blowers,<br>stepper motors, garage door controls and LED strip lighting.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Diodes also continues to support environmental sustainability through the efficiency improvement with our rectifiers in green factory automation<br>control equipment and high-speed robotics. Additionally, we gained increasing market share in inverter and Power-over-Ethernet applications<br>with our MOSFET and SBR products. We also secured increasing design wins for applications such as programmable logic controllers, IoT, security,<br>servo motor, power supplies, smart grip and energy. Also, we have been securing the new design wins from our Lite-On Semiconductor Image<br>Sensor product line in industrial automation machines including scanners, banknote detectors, check receipt and PCB inspection.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">In the Consumer market, DC-DC converters and bipolar transistors have been gaining strong growth in monitors, TVs, set-top boxes and cable<br>modems. Similarly, demand for our low power audio amplifier increased significantly along with new design wins for Schottky and SBR products<br>in smart speakers, wearable devices, smart routers and virtual reality applications.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:0.373%;text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:7.3pt;line-height:10.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">REFINITIV STREETEVENTS | www.refinitiv.com | Contact Us</font></p>

  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:1.3;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:0.92%;text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:0.0pt;line-height:14.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">NOVEMBER 03, 2021 / 9:00PM, DIOD.OQ - Q3 2021 Diodes Inc Earnings Call</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:20.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">With the integration of LSC manufacturing facilities, Diodes is now well positioned to support the strong demand for our bridge rectifier product<br>family in the consumer applications such as home theaters as well as smoke and carbon monoxide detectors.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Additionally, USB power delivery decoders and MOSFETs gained an increasing number of design wins in the wireless power charging solutions.<br>Our industrial smallest MOSFET fab is ramping up to meet the most critical demand in small footprint applications. We also experienced further<br>growth and new design wins for our USB MUX devices with high-voltage protection and ultra-high bandwidth features in the IoT applications.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Turning to Communication, we continue to drive increasing demand for our Pericom products in the 5G market. Our SPDT switch has been designed<br>into 5G Active Antenna Units with major a 5G equipment supplier. We're also seeing demand for PMOS to protect the 5G RF amplifier in the Remote<br>[Radio] (added by company after the call) Unit and NMOS in 5G-based power stations to reduce the power consumption.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Also, during the quarter we achieved significant traction for our high PSSR performance LDOs, battery FETs and SBR products in smartphone<br>applications. Diodes also saw increased revenue from optical applications for fiber optic equipment, including CWDM and DWDM modules as well<br>as switchgear and switchboard applications. Building on the success of our high-performance crystal oscillators from Pericom, our ultra-low jitter<br>crystal oscillator family also experienced tremendous growth in the optical modules.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Lastly, in the Computing market, revenue grew over 140% year-over-year to a record, driven by record Pericom revenue and the fourth consecutive<br>quarter of growth.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">The energy conservation trend continues in the commercial PC market, which requires our signal integrity Re-Drivers. We are seeing USB Type-C<br>and display port Re-Drivers, PMOS, USB-Power Delivery, buck converters and Omnipolar Hall sensor design wins in the notebook, motherboards<br>and AIO platforms. Additionally, strong demand for high-resolution displays propelled our HDMI/Display Re-Driver product to another volume<br>peak. HDMI 2.1 redrivers are designed in applications by mobile stations, gaming PCs and notebooks. And our newly released dua;-channel LED<br>driver for infrared LEDs has been winning designs with major PC manufacturers.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Along with Pericom products, Schottky and SBR products are also increasing our new design wins in cloud platforms and data center applications.<br>LSC's image sensor products have also been gaining new design-ins in scanners and multifunction printers.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.0pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">In summary, we are very pleased to have achieved our fourth consecutive quarter of record revenue, coupled with record performance across all<br>financial metrics. The continued success of our content expansion initiatives is evidenced by our record revenue in key targeted markets like<br>automotive, industrial, and computing, which has also served as a key contributor to our margin expansion. With our expectations for another<br>quarter of above seasonality results and record performance, we look forward to reporting our continuous progress.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:12.7pt;line-height:11.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">With that, we now open the floor to questions.   <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:32.65pt;line-height:11.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Emily Yang - Diodes Incorporated - SVP of Worldwide Sales &amp; Marketing</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:5.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Right.   <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:5.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Okay.   <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:24.25pt;line-height:11.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Emily Yang - Diodes Incorporated - SVP of Worldwide Sales &amp; Marketing</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:5.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Right. And one more, if I can just squeeze in here real quick, just on the gross margin side. How sustainable are the margin<br>trends do you think?</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:24.25pt;line-height:11.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Keh-Shew Lu - Diodes Incorporated - Chairman, CEO &amp; President</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:5.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Our principle is we only raise the price to reflect our cost increase. Okay? So when our vendor raised the price for wafer fab or building material,<br>we increased our ASP to reflect that cost increase. But majority of our gross margin improvement is not coming from the ASP increase. It is coming<br>from our manufacturing efficiency and our product mix. And when you look at the manufacturing efficiency, when we consolidated LSC at 1Q this<br>year, our GP went down 300 basis points. And this is because the manufacturing efficiency is not as great as Diodes. But then after we take over,<br>you can see our second quarter growth 270% basis points, our third quarter grew 210 basis points. It's all due to manufacturing efficiency and<br>product mix. Because from a product mix point of view, is that we grow much more in automotive area. And I already mentioned, 30% -- 30% CAGR,<br>and that gives you a much better gross margin. But manufacturing efficiency, I think even though the LSC manufacturing, we half loaded, and we<br>are now get to about the LSC, one of the fabs, is 91% in the fourth, in the third quarter. So those is really adding to the improvement of the gross<br>margin?</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:24.25pt;line-height:11.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Emily Yang - Diodes Incorporated - SVP of Worldwide Sales &amp; Marketing</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:5.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Yes. I think on top of that, we talk about LSC synergies, right? Besides the manufacturing synergy, we still have 3 other areas, which is product,<br>customer base, as well as the market segments. There's still a lot of room for us to continue to grow. We're also seeing a new wave of opportunities<br>especially open up a lot of new doors, new sockets at a lot of strategic customers. So we believe this is the beginning of it. And with our total<br>solution sales strategy, our content expansion focus, that will continue to help us drive the margin improvement in the near future.</font></p>

  <p style="text-indent:0.0%;font-size:10.0pt;margin-top:5.4pt;line-height:12.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0.0pt;text-align:left;"><font style="background-color:rgba(0,0,0,0);color:rgba(0,0,0,1);white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:9.0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">Our strategy is, even this shortage, capacity constraint, we have not raised the ASP crazy. We only reflect the ASP increase by our cost increase. So<br>our customer can understand why we need to raise the ASP. But we take this opportunity to develop the deeper relationship with our key customers.</font></p>
